title: Lowe: some brain causes act through a simultaneous mental state

statements.text: Lowe proposes that physical causes always bring about the effects physics predicts, but some brain causes do so indirectly, by bringing about a simultaneous mental state that causes the ordinary physical effect, so the mental contribution is invisible to scientific observation.

sources.quote: But certain physical causes in the brain do so indirectly, by bringing about an intermediate mental state that in turn causes the ordinary physical effect.
